Subject: Finalizing full-loop stitch for Ethan Cho — staggered panels & buffer plan

Hi all,

Thanks for jumping on this — we need to lock the virtual onsite for Ethan (Nimbus Labs pipeline) next week. Candidate is available Tue/Wed (Aug 10–11) in the US-PST window. Goal: a compact full loop that minimizes context switches while preserving domain-specific interviewers. Proposed structure below — please reply with hard vetoes or suggested swaps by EOD today: 

- 10:00–10:30 Tech 1 (system design) — Laura (lead) + Logan (follow)
- 10:35–11:05 Tech 2 (infra/runtime) — Logan (lead) + Kimberly
- 11:15–11:35 Lunch / break buffer (20m)
- 11:35–12:05 Product/PM sense — Marissa
- 12:10–12:35 Culture & bar-raiser — Neha
- 12:40–13:00 Hiring manager (wrap / fit / next steps) — Laura

Notes:
- We need at least a 15–20m buffer between heavy tech rounds for the candidate to rest and for interviewers to prep (this helps maintain quality).
- Candidate has asked for a short introductory 10-min call beforehand if possible. If we do that, I propose 09:50–10:00 quick intro with Priya + Laura (optional).

Attachments: draft agenda + one-pager on candidate profile attached.

Action items: everyone — confirm availability and any requested order changes. Log any conflicts in the Drive doc (link below). I’ll send the calendared invite to the candidate once we have consensus.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Recruiter, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

+1 on the buffer — heavy back-to-back design rounds burn people out. A couple of small notes: 

- Swap order: I'd prefer HM at the end as you suggested but can we push PM to immediately after Tech2 (so PM at 11:15) and keep the lunch/buffer at 12:00? That puts hiring manager at 12:10 and gives a longer wrap window.
- I can take lead on Tech1 but I’ll need Logan as primary for parts of the kernel/serving questions (so keep him in).

If that layout works, I’ll prepare a 5-question rubric for Tech1 and share with the panel this afternoon.
